grants.name: Resourceful
grants.text: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

grants.name: Skillful
grants.text: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

grants.name: Versatile
grants.text: You gain an Origin feat of your choice.

grants.name: Dwarven Resilience
grants.text: You have Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

grants.name: Dwarven Toughness
grants.text: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

grants.name: Stonecunning
grants.text: As a Bonus Action, you gain Tremorsense with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes, provided you and any surface you're standing on are made of stone.

grants.name: Keen Senses
grants.text: You have proficiency in the Insight, Perception, or Survival skill.

grants.name: Fey Ancestry
grants.text: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

grants.name: Trance
grants.text: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation.
